definitions.explanation: An adult female human. Also used as a prefix to indicate female gender of various things.

examples.notes: {女|おんな}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ is more polite than {女|おんな} alone

examples.japanese: ⟦トイレ→トイレ：00818_toire⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{男|おとこ}→男：00561_otoko⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{女|おんな}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{分|わ}かれています→分かれる：10976_wakareru⟧。
examples.english: The toilets are divided into male and female.
This song is popular with women, but it's also often listened to by men.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{女|おんな}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦{育|そだ}て→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧、⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}いていて→働く：00503_hataraku⟧、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しそう→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{笑顔|えがお}→笑顔：01884_egao⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: She works at a company while raising two girls, and although she seems busy every day, she's always smiling.

notes:
{女|おんな} means woman or female.

POLITENESS LEVELS:
- {女|おんな}: plain (can sound blunt)
- {女|おんな}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: polite (recommended)
- ⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧: formal/written

COMPOUNDS:
- {女|おんな}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧: girl
- {女|おんな}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: woman (polite)
- ⟦{女子|じょし}→女子：03350_joshi⟧: girl, female (as prefix)
- ⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧: woman, female (formal)
- ⟦{女優|じょゆう}→女優：03353_joyuu⟧: actress

KANJI READINGS:
- おんな: kun'yomi (standalone)
- じょ/にょ: on'yomi (in compounds)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {女|おんな}: woman ↔ ⟦{男|おとこ}→男：00561_otoko⟧: man
- ⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧: female ↔ ⟦{男性|だんせい}→男性：01655_dansei⟧: male

NOTE: Using {女|おんな} alone to refer to a specific person can sound rude; prefer {女|おんな}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧.
